code_findings.observed_in_code: round_id can be propagated in requests/versions/views/iterations/waits/artifacts; countsFor(task,{round_id}) filters before selecting latest version iterations/current image paths.
code_findings.limit: Caller must tag each actual event. File names do not infer tags. True per-round start/end metrics and round reports are not automatically written.

code_findings.observed_in_code: Metrics/report targets are task output roots. Top-level metrics include all task logs; rounds/case_metrics are detail. Suite aggregates task top-level plus shared only.
code_findings.limit: Do not add newly archived round/case counts again to task/suite totals.

code_findings.observed_in_code: Relative nested stems and additional-file destinations support round subdirectories while keeping original metadata round_id.
code_findings.limit: report_from writes task-level report, metrics_extra updates task-level metrics. It does not automatically archive round reports/metrics.

code_findings.observed_in_code: It requires declarations covering every current final, whole-task required-file/round checks, then taskEnd. Existing true root view IDs can be reused.
code_findings.limit: Whole-task close only; cannot be used as first/second round close. This preparation did not run a multi-round task.

code_findings.observed_in_code: Round filter and actual boundary event IDs define scope/timing; logs/hashes are rechecked before wx archive. Source correction must be explicit. Historical delivered-pointer view bytes can resolve to preserved matching raw responses without adding a view.
code_findings.limit: Actual round-boundary and archive branches remain unexecuted here. Content, quantity and visual quality remain root review responsibilities.

actual_commands.name: help
actual_commands.output:
Usage:
  node archive-round-metrics.cjs TASK ROUND_ID [--check-only]
    [--start-event EVENT_ID --end-event EVENT_ID]
  node archive-round-metrics.cjs --inspect-case TASK CASE_ID
  node archive-round-metrics.cjs --help

Round mode filters actual task logs by round_id. True start/end must come from
matching recorded round-start/round-started and round-complete/round-completed
events in _suite/events.jsonl; no timestamps or facts are invented.
Without explicit event IDs, each boundary must have exactly one matching event.
--check-only reports metadata and writes nothing. --inspect-case is read-only;
existing cases/pages are never relabelled rounds and boundary times stay null.
Archive writes an immutable temp copy and OUTPUT/TASK/ROUND_ID/task-metrics.json
with wx. Existing destinations are refused; state, reports and task-level metrics
are untouched. Source bytes/hashes and recorded IDs are verified, not perceived.
Round/case detail must never be added again to task/suite top-level totals.

actual_commands.name: help
actual_commands.output:
Usage:
  node archive-round-metrics.cjs TASK ROUND_ID [--check-only]
    [--start-event EVENT_ID --end-event EVENT_ID]
  node archive-round-metrics.cjs --inspect-case TASK CASE_ID
  node archive-round-metrics.cjs --help

Round mode filters actual task logs by round_id. True start/end must come from
matching recorded round-start/round-started and round-complete/round-completed
events in _suite/events.jsonl; no timestamps or facts are invented.
Without explicit event IDs, each boundary must have exactly one matching event.
--check-only reports metadata and writes nothing. --inspect-case is read-only;
existing cases/pages are never relabelled rounds and boundary times stay null.
Archive writes an immutable temp copy and OUTPUT/TASK/ROUND_ID/task-metrics.json
with wx. Existing destinations are refused; state, reports and task-level metrics
are untouched. Source bytes/hashes and recorded IDs are verified, not perceived.
Round/case detail must never be added again to task/suite top-level totals.
